citation.authors: Taylor S, Elbuluk N, Grimes P, Chien A et al
citation.journal: Journal of the American Academy of Dermatology

record.population: Ten US dermatologists (consensus), plus a literature review, for acne with dark marks
record.finding: Most people with acne and acne-related dark marks should get early, effective acne treatment with a topical retinoid and benzoyl peroxide. Hydroquinone, azelaic acid, chemical peels or antioxidants may be added. The authors say large randomised trials are lacking, so evidence-based recommendations cannot be made.

record.design: Modified Delphi consensus and literature review on acne-associated hyperpigmentation
record.finding: Large randomised trials of acne and acne-marks treatment are lacking, so evidence-based recommendations cannot be made. The panel agreed that most patients with acne and marks should get early, effective acne treatment with a topical retinoid and benzoyl peroxide. Hydroquinone, azelaic acid, chemical peel or antioxidants may be added.
record.note: Expert opinion. The authors say evidence-based recommendations cannot be made.
